Mark a chat as read when you send a message or a reaction there, including in secret chats. Requires \u00ABDon\'t send read receipts\u00BB. When off, sending does not allow read receipts.
Send all messages without notification sound. Works even when ghost mode is off.

Messages are sent as scheduled about 12 seconds later (20 seconds with media), so sending does not show you online. They appear in the chat when the server posts them. Forwards, story replies and Saved Messages are delayed too. Secret chats wait on this device before sending and show as sending during the delay; the app must be running. This does not hide your online status. Quick reply shortcuts are not delayed. Works even when ghost mode is off. Not recommended on a slow connection.
Delayed send is on: the message will be posted in a few seconds.
When the limit is reached, the oldest saved records are removed.
Spy settings and saved data are per account. Import adds records from an exported file to the current account and keeps existing ones. Secret chats are skipped, except read dates.

Hide sponsored messages: ads in channels, bots, videos and search are not loaded. Local Premium: unlocks whole-chat translation on this device only; Premium limits stay as they are. Work in background: keeps the connection open with a silent notification, so messages arrive without Google push.

Filters hide messages by keywords or regular expressions, hide users with a shadow ban and hide messages from blocked users. Messages are only hidden, not deleted. Your own messages are never filtered. Secret chats count as private chats.
Shared filters apply in groups and channels, and in private chats if enabled above. Changes apply when a chat is opened again.
Messages from these users are hidden in all chats. They are not notified.
Show messages from this user again?
Before opening stories, asks whether to view them without being counted as a viewer. Not shown while "Don\'t mark stories as viewed" is on.
The author will not see you in the viewers list of these stories.

Saves when your messages in private and secret chats are read, and shows it in the message menu when the server does not (hidden read time or an old message). The time is when this device got the update.
Saves the last known online time of people, also when they hide it (from their messages, typing and reading), including secret-chat typing. Very approximate.
Shows a ghost button in the chat list when ghost options are selected. Tap it to turn ghost mode on or off.
Deleted messages and edit history are not saved for the chats and users you pick here.
Some media from a protected chat was not forwarded: download it first.
Keeps a private copy of photos, videos and files of deleted messages if they were already downloaded. Chats from Spy exceptions, secret chats and self-destructing media are never saved.
